name: Heartsworn: A Knight's Game
source:
With a stranger’s challenge on your shoulders and beautiful hosts by your side, do you have what it takes to become a great knight?


[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
肩负陌生人发起的挑战，又有魅力四射的东道主相伴左右——你是否具备成长为一代伟大骑士的潜质？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
